items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember when Yougi Blake used to say that.

ctx.x: I think, somewhere, you characterized the contribution from the three of you. If you add up all the years of performing it’s something like 150 years of experience.

Oh, more. Now, cause I started in ’45 and this is 2010 and I’m still in, 2010! I guess its when you say you were born in the 1900’s that’s getting weird now to some kids. “Oh, I was born in 19—“ and “Whooo!” I remember when Yougi Blake used to say that.
